BiblicalUsage: The torch or lamp is the flame carried in the hand, and it burns in the covenant, in the battle, and in the visions. In Genesis 15:17 "a burning lamp" passed between the pieces of the covenant, in Judges 7:16 Gideon put lamps in the pitchers of his three hundred men, in Exodus 20:18 the people saw "the lightnings" on the mountain, and in Isaiah 62:1 Jerusalem's salvation goes forth "as a lamp that burneth."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this lamp is the light God carries into the dark: it sealed the covenant with Abraham, it won Gideon's battle, and it is the picture of the salvation that will not rest until it shines. From Abraham's covenant to Gideon's battle, the lamp is the light God carries into the dark.
